name: studypath-firebase-backend
description: Local-only Firebase Auth and Realtime Database contract and rule tests

scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:main && npm run test:interactive && npm run test:family:rules
scripts.test:integration:main: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs catalog/rules/*.test.mjs preferences/tests/*.rules.test.mjs downloads/*.rules.test.mjs materials/rules/*.test.mjs academics/*.rules.test.mjs reminders/*.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:family:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.b11-test.json --project demo-studypath-family-rules --only database "node --test --test-isolation=none --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 sharing/firebase-family.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:tooling: node --test --test-isolation=none --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 catalog/tests/*.test.mjs materials/tests/*.test.mjs sharing/tests/*.test.mjs mock/*.test.mjs rules/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:foundation: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node scripts/test-stage.mjs foundation"
scripts.test:auth: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node scripts/test-stage.mjs auth"
scripts.test:records: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node scripts/test-stage.mjs records"
scripts.test:readings: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node scripts/test-stage.mjs readings"
scripts.test:study: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node scripts/test-stage.mjs study"
scripts.test:academics: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-studypath --only auth,database "node scripts/test-stage.mjs academics"
